elements.text:
Theme	Core sub-themes	Illustrative quote	Meaning for operations
Manual reconciliation shifts effort from operations to error correction	Repeated recounting; after-hours verification; coordination strain.	"Sometimes it ends up in an argument because I am already loaded with work." (Interviewee 1)	Labor is redirected from serving customers and planning toward repetitive correction.
When records conflict, trust shifts to physical proof	Physical count as truth; signed slips and receipts preferred; slow confirmation.	"We usually check the actual physical stock first because that is the most reliable basis." (Interviewee 2)	Record systems have not earned enough trust to support fast decisions on their own.
